findings.quote: Treating the fall term as different for the two particles instead of letting it cancel leads to an incorrect collision time and a wrong horizontal distance.
findings.note: Vague: it names no concrete error a student makes and no number. Both balls carry the same −5t² term, so there is no natural way to make the fall terms differ; the real error on this question is on the horizontal step.
findings.fix: Using only ball A's horizontal motion for the gap gives d = 10×1 = 10 m; ball B also moves 10 m toward A in the same 1 s, so the gap closed is the sum, d = 20 m.
